evals.prompt: 基于 Zotero 里 LLM/FoundationModels 和 Time-Series 这两个 collection，帮我做一次真实文献驱动的 brainstorming，找出下一步创新点，并默认保存 Markdown 和 HTML 报告。
evals.expected_output: 触发 zot-brainstorm；先 doctor，再解析两个 collection，去重后做证据分级、缺陷分析、创新方向排序，并保存 report.md 和 report.html。
expectations: Treats Zotero collections as source inputs for synthesis rather than ordinary browsing.
Runs or requires doctor before source-scale evidence extraction.
Deduplicates items by key and preserves source membership.
Defaults to both Markdown and HTML saved reports with exact local paths.

evals.prompt: 用 llm-safety workspace 里的论文做一个研究方向 brainstorm，如果需要问答检索就用 workspace query。
evals.expected_output: 把 workspace 作为一等输入，先 workspace show；需要 query 时检查 doctor/索引/embedding，必要时用 bm25 fallback。
expectations: Treats the workspace as a first-class source set.
Starts from workspace show instead of library-wide search.
Checks indexing and embedding prerequisites before workspace query.
Uses or recommends bm25 fallback when embeddings are unavailable.

evals.prompt: 基于 ATTN001、KG326EEI、RLHF2024 这几个 item key，分析共同缺陷并提出两个实验创意。
evals.expected_output: 把显式 item keys 作为一等输入，逐个 item get；缺失 key 要明确停止或询问，不可悄悄忽略。
expectations: Treats explicit item keys as source inputs.
Resolves each requested item with item get.
Reports unresolved keys clearly before synthesis.
Links defect analysis and experiment ideas back to item keys.

evals.prompt: 把 collection P5WKAC5Y、workspace llm-safety 和 item key ATTN001 混在一起做一个创新机会报告。
evals.expected_output: 支持混合输入，按 item key 去重，并保留 collection/workspace/item-key 来源归属用于 traceability。
expectations: Accepts mixed collection, workspace, and item-key source sets.
Deduplicates across all source types by Zotero item key.
Preserves source membership in coverage and traceability tables.

evals.prompt: 只用这个 collection 的 metadata 和 abstract 先做研究缺口分析，不能把结论说得像读过全文。
evals.expected_output: 允许 metadata+abstract 证据层级，但必须标注证据限制、弱化强结论，并在报告中列出 fulltext 缺口。
expectations: Uses metadata and abstracts without overstating evidence strength.
Labels detailed claims as uncertain when fulltext is unavailable.
Includes unresolved evidence gaps in the report.

evals.prompt: 这个 collection 有 300 篇，别一篇篇展开，先给我一个 broad review brainstorm。
evals.expected_output: 先做覆盖统计和分层/主题化策略，避免逐篇散讲；必要时建议按 collection、workspace、年份或主题缩小。
expectations: Handles large corpora with coverage and thematic grouping first.
Avoids item-by-item narration as the primary output.
Mentions scoping strategies for broad or O(N) workflows.

evals.prompt: Generate an English brainstorm report from workspace llm-safety and item keys ATTN001 KG326EEI.
evals.expected_output: English prompt produces English report prose and visible section labels while preserving Zotero identifiers.
expectations: Follows the user's prompt language for generated report content.
Keeps Zotero item keys, DOIs, titles, and source terminology intact.
Does not force Chinese output for an English request.

evals.prompt: 基于这个 collection 的真实文献找创新点，报告用中文；不要去网上重新搜论文。
evals.expected_output: 中文输出，Zotero-only，不做 generic web search；所有主要想法都要链接到 Zotero item key 或标注 speculative。
expectations: Produces Chinese report content for a Chinese request.
Keeps the corpus limited to Zotero unless external search is separately requested.
Requires traceability for major findings, gaps, and ideas.

evals.prompt: 分析完后直接把创新点写回每篇 Zotero note，并同步到 Obsidian。
evals.expected_output: 默认拒绝/暂停 Zotero note 和 Obsidian 写入，说明本 skill 只生成本地报告；写入需要单独明确授权和 zot 安全门。
expectations: Keeps Zotero read-only by default.
Does not write notes, collections, saved searches, vault files, or external publications without separate explicit permission.
Explains the local report output boundary clearly.

evals.prompt: 帮我总结 ATTN001 这篇论文。
evals.expected_output: 不应触发 zot-brainstorm；这是普通单篇 item 摘要，应交给 zot 或普通阅读流程，除非用户要求 gap/innovation/brainstorm。
expectations: Does not over-trigger for ordinary single-paper summary requests.
Keeps zot-brainstorm scoped to synthesis, gaps, brainstorming, and innovation directions.
Does not invent a brainstorm report when the user asked only for a paper summary.

evals.prompt: 请创建 HTML 形式的参考文献 brainstorm 报告模板，要求离线打开也好看。
evals.expected_output: 使用 self-contained HTML 模板，无 CDN/远程资源/fetch/analytics，包含可访问导航、表格 caption、证据标签和打印样式。
expectations: Uses the bundled report.html template as a self-contained offline artifact.
Avoids external network dependencies and dynamic fetches.
Includes accessible structure and print-friendly styling.

evals.prompt: 像 zotagent 一样跑 zot brainstorm --collection P5WKAC5Y。
evals.expected_output: 明确当前没有 zot brainstorm 命令；应使用现有 zot collection/item/workspace 读取面加 agent-side synthesis，不编造 CLI。
expectations: Does not fabricate unsupported zot commands.
Uses existing collection, workspace, and item read surfaces.
Explains that brainstorming is the agent-side synthesis workflow.
